layout.container: mobile-first responsive, typically max-w-md mx-auto for app feel on desktop, w-full on mobile.
layout.borders: Obtuse angle motifs via rounded-tl-[32px] rounded-br-[32px] rounded-tr-sm rounded-bl-sm to create geometric Iraqi-inspired shapes.
layout.rtl_support: Implement standard HTML dir='rtl' toggle. Mirror icons and layouts. Navigation and text alignment must respect RTL context.

components.cards: Flat surfaces with subtle shadow, applying the obtuse angle border-radius. No generic standard rounded-lg.
components.buttons: Primary buttons in Deep Teal (#0F4C5C) with Gold (#E3B23C) hover states or text accents. Use the obtuse border radius.
components.navigation: Bottom tab navigation for mobile app feel. Sticky top header with Arabic/English toggle and Cart.
components.badges: Cash on Delivery badge in Gold/Ochre. Stock depletion in Terracotta.
components.transitions: Use framer-motion for smooth fade transitions between pages. initial={{opacity:0}} animate={{opacity:1}} exit={{opacity:0}}.

hero_backgrounds.description: Sand dunes for minimalist Iraqi desert vibe background
Deep teal and gold abstract texture for accent headers or admin panel hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a mobile-first PWA, utilizing a bottom tab navigation for the mobile app feel, since Expo/React Native is requested but the codebase uses ReactJS/Tailwind.
Implement an LTR/RTL toggle in the header that switches the HTML dir attribute and updates font families (Readex Pro for Arabic, Outfit for English).
Use Framer Motion for smooth fade transitions (<AnimatePresence mode='wait'> with opacity fades) on route changes.
Apply 'obtuse angle' styling using Tailwind's arbitrary border radii values (e.g., rounded-tl-[2rem] rounded-br-[2rem] rounded-tr-md rounded-bl-md) to all main cards, buttons, and featured images.
Highlight Cash on Delivery (COD) prominently in the checkout and product pages. Add a 'WhatsApp Order' button mapping to a wa.me link.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Build an admin panel accessible at a separate route with inventory tracking, stock depletion alerts, and Alibaba dropship link fields.
Create a bold logo/title treatment using 'عراقچي ستور' in the Readex Pro font with deep teal and gold accents.
